name: TripleFact
description: TripleFact is an evaluation framework designed to mitigate benchmark data contamination in fake news detection tasks for large language models. It integrates human-adversarial testing, real-time web validation, and entity-controlled environments to assess robustness and temporal generalization while eliminating entity-specific biases.
reputation: A relatively new research benchmark with limited but growing attention, mainly cited in work on contamination-resistant fake news and temporal robustness evaluation.
notes: Designed to resist data contamination effects and disentangle genuine detection capabilities from memorization artifacts.
